items.title: From help desk impersonation to AD CS abuse: Investigating ESC1 and ESC8 intrusion paths
items.summary: Teams support impersonation led to remote access, malicious runtime execution, and Certificate Services abuse through authentication relay and Kerberos.The post From help desk impersonation to AD CS abuse: Investigating ESC1 and ESC8 intrusion paths appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
items.creator: Microsoft Security Research, Sagar Patil, Jesse Birch and Tal Tzhori
